items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire in that direction only and never move the player. E places a bomb at the player's feet. Space/Q inert in an earlier run \u2014 don't retry. All heart outlines empty grey + bloodied player sprite = death, run over. Do NOT mistake the hopper's round white X-eyed face for the player's corpse (caused a false death call).

TECH X (observed): obtained by stepping onto the green/white pill that sits exactly at the two-poop room's top-hatch landing point (also seen from a red chest). Grants goggles, persists across rooms. Firing spawns a laser ring ~0.10 room-width ahead of the player in the fired direction, lingering ~1s and grinding overlapping targets. Placement is imprecise (small vertical offsets); reposition the player rather than hold fire. Works on poop piles (drop real '$'-faced coins) and draws RED CRACK-LIKE OUTLINES on rocks/chests \u2014 these are ring trails, NOT damage; rocks/chests showed no destruction after 5+ s. No effect on: '$' coin object, golden wall door, shelled hoppers (lasering one cost a heart), corner red-lidded chests, spike-ringed red chest, dark chest-room black blobs (4 s, no kill), white spike rings, decorative wall cracks. Props REGENERATE on re-entry (rocks, poop piles, spike rings) \u2014 grinding rooms is pointless.

COINS/PICKUPS (observed): real coins are small golden '$'-faced rounds; collected only by near-exact overlap while walking (count 00->01). Laser ignores them. Blue orbs = SOUL HEARTS (added 2 blue hearts over 1 red) \u2014 high value, grab them. Heart at full hearts converts to +1 bomb. Small yellow drip-like items near destroyed props are decorative/flicker in and out and change no counter.

CHESTS (observed): gray metal chests open by firing into them or by contact once enemies are dead. This run: torch room's central gray chest sat in a triangular rock ring, resisted contact and laser from afar; after bombing the ring, walking into it OPENED it and dropped a heart+bomb orb (healed to 3/3). So bomb the ring, then touch. Dark chest room: two corner red-lidded chests resist laser (key or mimic guess); contact with one cost several hearts at once; central red chest ringed by white spikes stayed closed.

BOMBS (observed): E places at feet; blast cracks/clears rock rings, but damages the player \u2014 a ~1.7 s retreat still cost a heart, so retreat ~2+ s or leave the room. Bombing white spike rings and decorative wall cracks did nothing. A bomb placed inside a rock pocket cleared rocks but cost a heart.

HAZARDS (observed): black spiders/dark blobs in the dark chest room are melee chasers; ring attacks did not kill them in ~4 s. Entering that room repeatedly cost 2+ hearts total; it yields nothing without keys \u2014 AVOID. Rock-field room white round-faced hoppers are extremely lethal: they phase (white puffs), ring themselves with spiky gray rocks, leave green splatter clouds and green blobs that damage on contact, and burst in green explosions. A swarm of three ended a run even with soul hearts. Corner torches damage on contact. Hazard hits cost 1-3 hearts. Stay 2+ tiles clear of hoppers and green blobs; leave the rock-field at low health or when a hopper approaches.

TRANSITIONS (observed): gold trapdoors need centered sustained S; crown hatches need precise x-center and sustained W pushed from ~0.1-0.2 room-height below (standing on top of the hatch frame can block the warp \u2014 step back down and re-center). Trapezoid doorways/alcoves need sustained walking plus fairly precise centering. Confirmed routes: tutorial TOP trapezoid -> rock-field; tutorial BOTTOM trapezoid -> torch room; tutorial RIGHT-wall doorway (vertical band ~y0.47, needs near-exact vertical centering) -> dark chest room; torch room TOP alcove (x~0.50) -> tutorial; torch room BOTTOM trapdoor -> two-poop room; two-poop room TOP crown hatch -> torch room. Dark chest room's LEFT-wall brown doorway (~x0.24,y~0.47) exits back to tutorial (pressing D in the tutorial re-enters it \u2014 beware). Torch room right-wall marking is decorative.

MAP (observed): Tutorial room (WASD hint wall, top+bottom trapezoids, right doorway y~0.47). Below -> torch room (gray chest in rock ring, 4 corner torches, brown poop pile, top alcove to tutorial, bottom trapdoor). Below that -> two-poop room (two piles \u2014 LEFT is an indestructible dark blob, RIGHT is real and drops a coin; Tech X pill at hatch landing; only exit top hatch). Above tutorial -> rock-field room (many rocks, golden keyhole door on left wall ~x0.19,y0.49, hoppers, green clouds). Right of tutorial -> dark chest room (corner red-lidded chests, spiked central red chest, blobs/spiders, left-wall exit).

UNRESOLVED: what opens the golden wall door and red-lidded/spiked chests (no keys ever seen; HUD always 00); rock-field top door/alcove resisted many centered W attempts (decorative or blocked); source of keys and of health drops.

FAILED STRATEGIES: contact/lasering locked or mimic chests with no keys; expecting laser crack outlines to mean damage; bombing spike rings and decorative cracks; lingering in the dark chest room; close-range firing (ring overshoots); hugging torches; exploring the rock-field at 1 heart; assuming an open lane is clear.
